receipt.selection: select_slices_by_shot on the frozen decomposition bank

control_caveat: This is a control and not a parity claim, because the tared field is derived from the reference own map and hands the solve information no production run would have; it bounds the GS solve own fidelity and attributes the residual, and must never be cited as parity.

tare_construction.plasma_composition: ForwardFluxOperator.current_moment_image with centroid current moments, the same grid and wall kernels used by the forward map
tare_construction.delta_star_interpretation: interior Delta-star removes conductor fields outside the grid; the external field is recovered by subtraction

gauge.rule: preserve the stored reference total-flux gauge

banked_comparison.comparison_note: The table reports the reference-own Delta-star current outside each declared support separately from the support integral.

passive_inclusive_comparison.figure_provenance: retained from the closure-gated exact-kernel build in this worker run

decisive_readout_declared_before_measure.measure: number of six references reaching a converged nonzero plasma root at 1e-8
decisive_readout_declared_before_measure.marked_improvement_reading: external-field error was material and the GS solve is sound
decisive_readout_declared_before_measure.unchanged_near_one_of_six_reading: external field is exonerated; the obstacle is the GS fixed point or discretisation

aggregate.statement: The tared root count regressed from one of six to zero of six and the identical split fails the analytic external-field null. This is evidence against a faithful background split, not evidence about the Grad--Shafranov fixed point or discretisation.

solovev_analytic_null.purpose: non-tautological attribution test against independently known closed-form plasma current and analytic external field
solovev_analytic_null.separation: the identical Delta-star, valid-stencil centroid-current image, and subtraction used for the six MAST controls
solovev_analytic_null.finding: The Delta-star density converges to the analytic source on valid stencils, but the identical finite-mesh plasma image does not recover the independent analytic external field; the MAST tared root count is therefore void for residual attribution.

attribution_adjudication.finding: The tared root count regressed from one of six to zero of six and the identical split fails the analytic external-field null. This is evidence against a faithful background split, not evidence about the Grad--Shafranov fixed point or discretisation.

conductor_localisation.reason: The analytic external field was not recovered, so spatial attribution of the MAST exterior current cannot rescue this tare.
